customSections.label: Does This Calendar Apply to Every Hawaii Public School?
customSections.content: HIDOE currently lists the 2027–28 PDF as a future statewide school calendar. Its calendar page identifies Holomua Elementary and charter schools as exceptions for 2026–27 but does not repeat that language under the future-year listing. Families at those schools should confirm the 2027–28 calendar directly with their school. This page does not assume that a 2026–27 exception or alternate calendar automatically carries forward to 2027–28.

customSections.label: Hawaii Calendar Notes — 2027–28
customSections.content: These details come from HIDOE’s official calendar page and the footnotes on the 2027–28 one-page calendar.

groups.label: Institute Day and converted planning days
items: One no-student Institute Day will fall during October 18–22, 2027; the exact date is determined by island.
Two instructional days are converted to non-student days for school planning and collaboration. HIDOE has not published fixed statewide dates for them.

groups.label: Teacher work year
items: HIDOE lists a 193-day teacher work year. Teachers report to campus for 189 days, while four additional days are converted to 27 hours: 21 hours for job-embedded professional development and six hours for training, planning, assessment, or teacher-evaluation meetings.

groups.label: Student days, hours, and the senior schedule
items: The PDF shows 89 first-semester days and 93 second-semester days, then subtracts the two converted planning days for a total of 180 student days. HIDOE says Hawaii schools must provide 180 days totaling 1,080 hours.
The last day for seniors may be scheduled no earlier than May 10, 2028. That is a statewide threshold, not one graduation date; individual schools publish their own senior and commencement schedules.

breakNotes.2027-12-20: Winter Break ends December 31. January 3 is a teacher workday, so students return Tuesday, January 4.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2026–27
whatsNew.subtitle: A concise comparison with the amended 2026–27 HIDOE calendar.
content: The first student day moves from August 3 in 2026–27 to August 2 in 2027–28, while the last student day moves from May 27 to May 24.
Fall Break moves from October 5–9 to October 4–8; Winter Break moves from December 21–January 1 to December 20–31; and Spring Break moves from March 15–19 to March 13–17.
The Institute Day window moves from February 8–12 in 2026–27 to October 18–22 in 2027–28.
The teacher work year begins July 27, one day earlier than the July 28 start in 2026–27.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the 2027–28 statewide calendar apply to every Hawaii public school?
calendarFaqs.a: HIDOE currently publishes the 2027–28 PDF as a future statewide school calendar. Its calendar page identifies Holomua Elementary and charter schools as exceptions for 2026–27 but does not repeat that statement under the future-year listing, so families at those schools should confirm their 2027–28 calendar directly.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the October 18–22 Institute Day window?
calendarFaqs.a: One no-student Educational Officer and Teacher Institute Day will occur during October 18–22, 2027. HIDOE does not publish one statewide date for it; the exact day is determined separately for each island.

calendarFaqs.q: Why is January 3, 2028, a no-student day?
calendarFaqs.a: January 3 is a teacher workday. Students return from Winter Break and begin the second semester on Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does HIDOE have a 193-day teacher work year if teachers report to campus for 189 days?
calendarFaqs.a: HIDOE defines a 193-day teacher work year. Teachers report to campus for 189 days, while four additional days are converted to 27 hours for professional development, training, planning, assessment, or teacher-evaluation meetings.

calendarFaqs.q: What does ‘last day for seniors: no sooner than May 10’ mean?
calendarFaqs.a: HIDOE permits schools to schedule the last day for seniors on or after May 10, 2028. May 10 is the earliest allowed date, not a single statewide senior last day or graduation date; individual schools publish their own schedules.

sourceReviewSummary: Official calendar approved May 15, 2025. MySchoolDates reviewed the current HIDOE calendar page and the complete 2027–28 PDF on August 20, 2026.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How the 2027–28 Hawaii calendar was checked
sourceReviewDetails: We reviewed the complete date grid, semester and quarter counts, state holidays, teacher work-year notes, and every footnote in the official PDF.
We also checked the HIDOE calendar page for the status of the future-year PDF and the 180-day/1,080-hour requirement.
Dates without a fixed statewide value, including Institute Day and two converted planning/collaboration days, are not represented as fixed dates in our ICS file.
sourceMaintainerText: The Hawaii State Department of Education publishes and revises the official statewide calendar.
